Name: Vintage Reshade - for Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR)
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
A Reshade preset custom made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR) [/url]and heavily tweaked according to the lighting changes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2072]Dynamic Night Time[/url], to add a vintage feel for this beautiful recolor mod.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR)[/url]﻿ is [b]required[/b]
[*][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/664041-dynamic-night-time]Dynamic Night Time[/url]﻿﻿ (lighting mod) ([b]Optional[/b], if you don't use it, daytime will still look like the screenshots, but nighttime will be slightly different).
[/list]
[b][u]Installation:

[/u]（中文安装方式请看发帖区）
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR)[/url].
[*]([b]Optional[/b]) Install [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/664041-dynamic-night-time]Dynamic Night Time[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download and [b]extract[/b] the [b]Vintage Reshade[/b] file.
[*]Download [b]reshade installer[/b] from [b][url=https://reshade.me/]https://reshade.me/[/url]﻿ [/b] and run the installer.
[*][b]Browse[/b] and select [b]StardewModdingAPI [/b]in your [b]game installation folder[/b]. For example, the correct folder for Steam user is something like: C:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
[*]Choose [b]OpenGL[/b].
[*][b][u][b][Important ! ][/b][/u] ﻿Browse[/b] and [b]select[/b] the Preset file [b]Vintage.ini [/b]that you have extracted earlier. Proceed until you finish the installation.
[*][b][u][b][Important ! ][/b][/u] [/b]Copy the [b]"reshade-shaders" [/b]folder that you have extracted earlier, and paste on the one that you have installed in your [b]game installation folder[/b] earlier. You have to [b]overwrite [/b]the files when asked.
[*]If you don't like the wash-out effect of Reshade on the portrait of dialogue UI, download the [b]Dialogue UI Mask[/b] files, and do the following:
[/list][spoiler]
1. [b]Dialogue UI Mask [/b]needs to detect certain part of the dialogue UI, hence only works if all of the following conditions are met:
[list]
[*][b]Full-screen [/b]or [b]Window Borderless Mode[/b]
[*][b]UI scale 100% [/b](Not the Zoom Level, you can use any Zoom Level)
[*][b]Vanilla UI[/b] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface V2[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url]﻿ (recommended)﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16970]Cozy Accent Interface (Dark Version)[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams UI[/url]﻿or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17912]VPR Inspired UI[/url]
[*] [b]Screen resolutions[/b]: [b]1920x1080, 2560x1440 [/b]or [b]3840x2160[/b]
[/list]2. Extract the [b]Dialogue UI Mask[/b] that you have downloaded, and open the folder according to the type of UI and resolution of your game.
3. Copy the [b]"reshade-shaders" [/b]folder, and paste on the one that you have installed in your [b]game installation folder[/b] earlier. You have to [b][b]overwrite[/b][/b] the files when asked.

* If you want to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies -- Weather- and Time-Dependent UI[/url]﻿, set to [b]false[/b] for [b]RoundedCorners[/b].

* If you think any UI mod may look great with this preset, you may suggest it, and I may make the UI mask if I'm interested.
[/spoiler]

[b][u]GMCM Config Suggestion:
[/u][/b]To look like my screenshots:
[spoiler]
1. VPR config:
  "Green Fall": "true",
  "Water Type": "opaque",

2. SVE config:
  "MistEffects": "false",
[/spoiler]

[b][u]FAQ:[/u][/b]
How to change things you don't like:
[spoiler]

[list=1]
[*]You can customize the preset in-game. Press [b]Home[/b] in your game. Untick [b]Performance Mode[/b] to start tweaking.
[*][b]Too sharp [/b](at lower resolution)? Tweak [b]qUINT_sharp[/b] for sharpness. (My suggestion: 0.4 for 1440p and 4K resolution, 0.2 or lower for 1080p)
[*]Tweak [b]Vibrance[/b] for overall color saturation
[*]Untick [b]ChromaticAberration[/b]- turn off the slightly blurrier effect noticeable on texts
[*][b]Too dark? [/b]Try adjusting the value under[b] EyeAdaption[/b]
[*]You can [b]turn off[/b] [b]show fps[/b] under [b]Setting[/b] tab.
[*]You can set an effect toggle hotkey under [b]effect toggle key [/b]([b]Setting[/b] tab).
[/list][/spoiler]


[b]***Main recolor mods for the visual like my screenshots***
[/b][spoiler][b]
1. Main Recolor:
[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor for SVE[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6767]﻿grapeponta's Vanilla Interiors (VPR interiors only)[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14928]﻿Redraw Pelican Town Expanded (VPR)[/url]﻿﻿ ﻿
[*]East Scarp VPR available on ES discord channel
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14369](Recolor) Ridgeside Village - Deon's Earthy toned down colors[/url]﻿ - this is not VPR, but I use it and have adjusted my Reshade to look decent with it.
[/list]
[b]2. Lighting:
[/b][list]
[*][b] [/b][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/664041-dynamic-night-time]Dynamic Night Time[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]3. Trees and Grass[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15033]Anette's Clover Grass[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6742]Flowergrass and Snowfields[/url] for grass.
[/list]
[b]4. Town Buildings:
[/b]These optional buildings mod look great with this preset:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14524]Elle's Town Buildings[/url]- use the Starblue Palette (like my screenshots), you can copy all the files in the Starblue folder and replace those in Elle folder.
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url]﻿ - comes with VPR palette
[/list][/spoiler]

﻿[b][u]Credits [/u][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2852735]JefGrizli[/url] for still updating recolor assets for VPR
Mod authors that are willing to add VPR color palette

Also special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453?tab=about+me]AirynS[/url] for the name of this reshade, and friends on SDV and ES discord channels for showing interests, and providing feedback and supports.
